name: deside
description: DeSide — let the internet deside. React + TypeScript SPA on Firebase.
author: Paavas Bhasin <paavas22@gmail.com>

scripts.install:all: npm ci && npm --prefix app ci && npm --prefix functions ci
scripts.bootstrap: npm install && npm --prefix app install && npm --prefix functions install
scripts.dev: firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions "npm --prefix app run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix functions run build && npm --prefix app run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix app run typecheck && npm --prefix functions run typecheck && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json --noEmit
scripts.lint: npm --prefix app run lint && npm --prefix functions run lint
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:rules && npm run test:functions
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project deside-test "vitest run --config vitest.rules.config.ts"
scripts.test:functions: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions --project deside-test "vitest run --config vitest.functions.config.ts"
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run build && firebase deploy --project staging
scripts.deploy:prod: npm run build && firebase deploy --project prod
scripts.preview: npm run build && firebase hosting:channel:deploy preview --expires 7d
